topic: Counts the Overview cannot show yet
detail: The Spaces pane shows no chunk counts per space (needs a collection per space, SP-024), counts quarantine as live sessions pinned to quarantine plus unconfirmed GitHub orgs rather than quarantined chunks (SP-028), and never shows relabel progress (SP-027): no RPC reports them. SpacesOverviewModel takes a relabel source and SpacesBadge already orders relabel last. Adding them needs fields in ListSpaces or SpacesStatus, an orchd.proto change for the coordinator to schedule.
